reviews.text: My doggie looked and smelled much better after her appointment.  And the staff was very helpful.

I’ve been a regular customer at Doggie Style Pets in Fishtown for the past two years, but my recent experience has me looking elsewhere.

I received a call a few days before my grooming appointment informing me that Calvin had suddenly left the company and that my appointment later this week was being canceled. I was told it was entirely my responsibility to reschedule, despite the inconvenience, and there was no effort to offer any compensation or accommodation.

This is actually the second time an appointment I’ve scheduled weeks in advance has been canceled , and due to scheduling issues and backlogs it takes usually months to get in with someone again. When I asked if there was anything they could do, I was simply told there wasn’t.

I understand that employees leave and unexpected situations happen, but good customer service is about how a business responds. After two years as a loyal customer, I expected more than “there’s nothing we can do.”

If you’re looking for a groomer that prioritizes customer service and values long-term clients, I’d recommend patronizing another location that doesn’t behave like a PetSmart corporate franchise.

7/28: Spoke with the manager of the store at 9:30a who said she didn’t have the authority to issue any credits for the inconvenience but she would get back to me by noon. Never received a call back that day or the next, 7/29.

7/29: called back and got an employee who advised me to email customer service

This will be probably my 5th phone call/email about this issue. I dont get the sense of ownership or proactive-ness from the store manager

Added some before picture showing basic grooming wasn’t done I requested on her front legs that was not performed either, which I had to take care of myself (before pic is after grooming, after is after my own work)

Have taken my pup to Doggie Style locations in Queen Village and Fairmount previously, but this was a first time trip to their location in Fishtown for a grooming appt. Just as great of an experience as I've had elsewhere, service was friendly from start to finish, the groomer inquisitive as to how I'd like her cut, and the pup was happy upon pick up - can't ask for much more than that!

I have been coming here and getting my dog groomed for a while now. Calvin is excellent and does an amazing job! And my dog enjoys going here-it is a win.

Update: got a neat-up groom recently for my dog’s bday. Calvin once again did a fantastic job (& the bandanna was so cute!).

Last week, the owner came into the store and verbally assaulted an employee, humiliating her in front of her peers and customers, and followed her out of the store, up the block and around the corner.

Searching job boards to try to find context on the interaction painted a very clear picture of how badly the employees are treated. When you love animals but abuse humans who also love animals because you’re too cheap to properly staff your stores, your mission in helping animals somehow becomes much less admirable. Any store I’ve ever visited, the employees seem stretched thin and stressed out, and after seeing this happen, I completely understand why. Disgusting humans don’t deserve our money.

Please, stop patronizing this chain. Every dollar spent at this small business is detracting from other small businesses who deserve your support.

The store has a big selection but their prices are really high compared to other pet stores in the area. They also have very unfriendly policies. I bought a $24 stuffed toy here and specifically chose it because the tag said '8/10 on the toughness scale'. After taking it home, my dog put a massive hole it in less than 5 hours. I took it back the next day and the staff was nice but said company policy was not to do anything if the tag was off. I was only looking for store credit, as l've spent more than $1 K as a customer there, and they wouldn't do it. I don't understand why you'd sell products you don't stand behind. Other pet stores in the area have way better policies, and just as good of selection. I'll only shop at Ham and Bone down the street from here on out.

Doggie Style Pets Fishtown is the best place. Their staff is super friendly, remembers your pups and the selection of food, treats, supplies etc is amazing. Calvin, their groomer, is so great with both my doggies - they always come out freshy fresh and happy. I just love my local pet shop :)

Best spot in Fishtown for everything pets! Great for grooming as well. Dan is the best! So friendly and welcoming. Excellent customer service at this location!

That being said, this is the only time I have ever felt that I got exactly what I asked for with a groomer! Thank you Calvin, I really appreciate it. My dog Arlo looks like a silly muppet and it’s just what I wanted :)

I have taken my dog here a few times to be groomed and he always ends up looking and smelling so good! Calvin does a great job! I know my dog can be a little bit tough when it comes to bathing and nail trims and they always get it done!
We have always had a great experience here, they do a fantastic job in grooming my pup and her leaving with her tail wagging!
AWESOME.. Just AWESOME to take Gizmo To Doggie Style. Dan and Calvin are GREAT

DO NOT LET BIANCA GROOM YOUR DOG!!
Bianca butchered my beautiful chow chow’s haircut by taking clippers all over her body and shaved her down!
I told Bianca my dog goes to the groomers every 6 weeks so her fur was only slightly grown out and she just needed a trim. In addition to her regular grooming visits, I brush my dogs fur daily. Her fur was immaculate except for the light trim I thought we were getting.
When I picked up my dog I was shocked to see her fur completely gone. My dog is now 1. Cold and 2. Because she’s a chow chow is at risk of her fur being ruined for the rest of her life!
Additionally, her ears are cut uneven and her face is lopsided. There are marks in her fur from improper use of the clippers. She had a gorgeous mane around her neck that is now gone. There was no skill used for her cut, she simply used one guard all over her body.
I addressed these concerns with owner Howard Nelson who refused to refund the $125 I paid for Bianca to destroy my dogs coat. The only thing worse than Bianca is Howard and his poor business practice. Howard claimed he “investigated” the situation and offered me a free groom in the future…why would I ever go back after what they did to my dog? Also why are you “investigating” a paying, loyal(I’ve been shopping here for years!!!)customer? The customer is always right! Not only was Bianca wrong but she is unprofessional, did not listen to my requests and clearly does not know about specific breeds and their needs. Do not trust these people with your dogs. Do not support this business. I’ve been purchasing food and supplies here for years but after the horrible experience I had with Howard…I will never be back. He could have just refunded me and apologized(like a respectable business owner would do).He also stated he would respond to this review accordingly….I’m sure he will spin this however he wants. I never complain but this is by far the WORST customer service I’ve ever experienced and the WORST haircut I’ve ever seen. Howard Nelson does not know how to run a business. Do not give him your money!
To add: I was so excited to have you folks as my groomers since I had been shopping here for years. I was planning on becoming a regular customer every 6 weeks. If you had proper customer service about this situation I would have still considered it. I understand people make mistakes and even an apology from Bianca would have made a difference.
The one star is for the really nice manager who actually cared and did his best- he clearly just works for a horrible business owner.

Definitely my go-to for grooming :) I have also gotten my dog’s harness from there, and to this date it is the best harness I’ve purchased for him.
